title: Aptamer-Based Target Detection Facilitated by a 3-Stage G-Quadruplex Isothermal Exponential Amplification Reaction
protocol: Collect 5 U of T4 polynucleotide kinase in a PCR tube.
Add 1 µL of preprepared 5x ribozyme buffer to each sample tube.
For specificity testing, add 1.5 µL of 2 mM theophylline or 2 mM caffeine to each sample tube as test samples.
Mix each sample tube thoroughly by pipetting 5-10 times.
Add 2 μL of 600 nM RNA containing an aptameric domain specific to the target to each sample tube.
Mix quickly by pipetting to make a final concentration of 240 nM in 5 μL of test solution.
Place the samples on a cold block to minimize background signal.
Incubate each sample (5 µL) at room temperature (23 °C) for exactly 3 min using a timer.
Return the sample tubes to ice (4 °C) immediately after incubation.
Add 3.5 μL of nickase-polymerase enzyme mixture to each sample tube and mix well.
Add 31.5 µL of EXPAR reaction mixture containing template, nucleotides, and reaction buffer to each sample tube.
Incubate each prepared sample (40 µL) at 55 °C for exactly 5 min using a timer.
Return the sample tubes to ice (4 °C) immediately after the incubation step.
Add 2 µL of Hemin solution to each sample tube and mix well.
Add 58 µL of TMB solution to each sample tube and mix well.
Incubate the color development reaction at room temperature for at least 3 min and up to 30 min.
(Optional) Add 20 µL of 2 M sulfuric acid to stop the color development.
Read the samples qualitatively by eye or quantify the results using an absorbance plate reader at 450 nm if sulfuric acid is used.
